modern: To the rational creature the same act is in keeping with nature and in keeping with reason.
original: To the rational animal the same act is according to nature and according to reason.
notification: To the rational creature the same act is in keeping with nature and in keeping with reason.
notification_original: To the rational animal the same act is according to nature and according to reason.

explained.summary: For a reasoning being, acting according to nature and acting according to reason are the same thing. Stoics held that what makes humans distinctive is their capacity to reason, so living well as a human simply means living by good reason.
